quote: Patience, patience, patience, is what the sea teaches. Patience and faith. One should lie empty, open, choiceless as a beach—waiting for a gift from the sea.
source: Anne Morrow Lindbergh, Gift from the Sea, chapter 1, The Beach (Pantheon, 1955)
